ages.question: Which age groups are the courses for?
ages.answer: The published course journey ranges from Garden Snail for children aged 8–12 months to Parachutes for ages 11–14. The currently suitable group depends on age and learning level. The transition between 12 months and age 2 will be reconfirmed with Pat before publication.

trial.question: Can my child attend a trial lesson first?
trial.answer: Yes. The existing website describes the trial lesson as non-binding and arranged directly with the course lead. Parents and children are asked to bring non-slip socks. The final enquiry channel still needs to be confirmed with Pat.

method.question: How do children learn during the course?
method.answer: English is experienced through the immersion method in understandable situations. Children listen, speak, sing, rhyme, play and move. Images, objects and creative materials help connect new words with meaning.

cambridge.question: Is Cambridge exam preparation available?
cambridge.answer: Yes. SprachOase has prepared learners for Cambridge exams since 2014. The appropriate step from A1 to C1 depends on level and goals; format, reading, writing, listening and speaking are prepared in a focused way.

location.question: Where do the lessons take place?
location.answer: SprachOase is located at Vahrenwalder Straße 78, 30165 Hannover-Vahrenwald-List. Appointments and trial lessons should be arranged directly in advance.

availability.question: When are courses held, how large are the groups and what do they cost?
availability.answer: Current schedules, available places, group sizes, duration and prices are not documented completely and reliably in the available public information. These details will be confirmed with Pat before they are published as binding information.

privacy.title: Privacy information
privacy.description: Transparency about the data flows currently implemented

scope.title: Data-minimising implementation
scope.description: This notice covers the current GitHub Pages demo, including local preferences, contact links, supplied photographs and review excerpts. Hosting arrangements, image releases and operator details require legal approval before the final production launch.

current.title: 2. Current functionality
current.description: This single-page website is designed to minimise data use.
current.noAnalytics: No analytics, advertising or profiling trackers
current.noNonEssentialStorage: No non-essential cookies or comparable storage access
current.noEmbeds: No embedded maps, videos, webfonts or social-media content
current.noForm: No web form; WhatsApp, email and telephone are opened only after a deliberate link click

storage.title: 3. Local preferences
storage.description: Language, colour scheme and accessibility options are stored only in the browser so the expressly chosen presentation can be retained. These settings do not create a usage profile.
storage.legalBasis: Storage is used solely to provide website functions expressly requested by the user. Where Section 25 TDDDG applies, it is strictly necessary storage under Section 25(2)(2) TDDDG; no server-side profile is created.
storage.retention: Retention: until the website data is deleted in the browser or the relevant preference is reset.

hosting.title: 4. Hosting and server logs
hosting.description: The demo is delivered through GitHub Pages. GitHub states that a visitor’s IP address is logged and stored for security purposes whenever a Pages site is visited, regardless of sign-in status. Further technically necessary connection data may be processed. Website delivery and security rely on the legitimate interest in a secure and stable online service under Article 6(1)(f) GDPR. International transfers by GitHub are governed by the safeguards described in the provider’s privacy statement.

contact.title: 5. Contact by email, telephone or WhatsApp
contact.description: When a person makes contact, SprachOase processes the voluntarily supplied contact details and course-enquiry information in order to respond and suggest a suitable course. The legal basis is pre-contractual steps under Article 6(1)(b) GDPR or the legitimate interest in handling enquiries under Article 6(1)(f) GDPR. The prepared email may contain information about a child; please provide only necessary details and no health data or other particularly sensitive information.
contact.whatsapp: WhatsApp is not embedded in the website. It is opened only after the link is deliberately activated. If a message is then sent, WhatsApp or Meta processes its own connection, device and communication data under its applicable terms. Email and telephone are available as alternatives.
contact.retention: Enquiries are deleted once handling is complete unless contractual, evidential or statutory retention requirements prevent deletion.

links.title: 6. External links
links.description: Links to WhatsApp, email, telephone, Google Maps or Google reviews do not load those providers’ content into this website. The provider’s website or app opens only when a link is activated; its privacy terms apply from that point.

media.title: 7. Photographs and review excerpts
media.description: Photographs and shortened review excerpts are delivered as local website files or editorial content, so displaying them does not connect to Google. Public surnames in reviews are abbreviated. Photographs of identifiable people—especially minors—may be published only with documented, valid permission from the people concerned or their legal guardians. Consent may be withdrawn for the future.

rights.title: 8. Data-subject rights
rights.description: Subject to the GDPR, data subjects may in particular request access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, object to processing and withdraw consent. Requests can be emailed to the address shown with the subject “Privacy”.
rights.authority: Open the complaint service of the Data Protection Commissioner of Lower Saxony

accessibility.title: Accessibility information
accessibility.description: Current status and website accessibility features

commitment.title: Our aim
commitment.description: SprachOase wants the website to be understandable and usable by as many people as possible. Development is guided by semantic HTML, clear contrast, reliable keyboard operation and an adaptable presentation.

features.title: Already implemented
features.keyboard: Keyboard-operable navigation, dialogs and accordions with visible focus indicators
features.preferences: Adjustable font size, typeface, line spacing, motion, links, focus and headings
features.structure: Skip link, semantic page regions, heading structure and meaningful labels

status.title: Review status

feedback.title: Report a barrier
